t: Moor Cat | Shannara Wiki - Exploring the Magical World of Shannara | Fandom
s: October 29, 2024 - Moor cats are large cats that can blend in perfectly with their surroundings. They are almost never seen outside of their natural home in the Eastland forests, as their ability to camouflage themselves would not work well anywhere else. They were first depicted in The Wishsong of Shannara.
